description: This Java source file defines an immutable class `ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapter` that implements thread-safe logging functionality with MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) support, integrating with Akka's `DiagnosticLoggingAdapter`. It provides methods for constructing instances, managing MDC entries, and forwarding logging calls with extended context, used for structured and contextual logging within the project.

classes.name: ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapter
classes.description: An immutable, thread-safe implementation of a logging adapter that extends `ThreadSafeDittoLoggingAdapter`, providing MDC management and integration with Akka diagnostics.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of `ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapter` using a factory for `DiagnosticLoggingAdapter`, initializing MDC as empty.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Constructs a new `ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapter` with optional MDC entries merged into existing MDC.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns a new adapter instance with a specified correlation ID added to MDC, either from a CharSequence or headers.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the correlation ID from MDC.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds or removes a single MDC entry based on key and value.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds multiple MDC entries in one call.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry by key.

methods.name: isErrorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if error level logging is enabled.

methods.name: isWarningEnabled
methods.description: Checks if warning level logging is enabled.

methods.name: isInfoEnabled
methods.description: Checks if info level logging is enabled.

methods.name: isDebugEnabled
methods.description: Checks if debug level logging is enabled.

methods.name: notifyError
methods.description: Logs an error message, optionally with a Throwable cause.
